messages:
Theo: quick follow-up from the all-hands runtime section. collecting a short checklist so teams know what to watch during kernel rollouts.

Rae: thanks — can we get the minimum telemetry set SRE needs?

Theo: yes: p50/p95/p99 latency, per-route batch-size p50/p90/p99, kv cache hit-rate, GPU mem headroom, kernel-selection events.

Vik: abort conditions? we need clear thresholds.

Theo: hard aborts: p99 > 2x baseline, OOM spikes, token error-rate > 3x. soft alerts: p95 > 1.25x, kv hit-rate drop > 20%, batch rejection > 5%.

Rae: rollout tempo? small steps or faster?

Theo: conservative: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100%, with 12-24h holds. adjust if signals stable.

Vik: customers asking if they need to change anything.

Theo: no breaking changes. we will expose opt-in flags: "kernel_autotune": true, "adaptive_cache": true. we'll add a one-line release note and deep-dive doc.

CI-Bot: ci/rollout-checklist created for experiment/kernel-v3 at 1815001701 :white_check_mark:

Rae: nice. I'll add dashboards and a rollback runbook. Vik, can you draft the release note one-liner?

Vik: sure: "Runtime upgrade: improved kernel selection and adaptive caching to reduce latency and cost. No action required; opt-out via route settings."

Theo: perfect. I'll post the release thread with links to the docs and ownerships. Ping here for any post-rollout anomalies.
